name: Trifluridine-Tipiracil (TAS-102)

source.nccn: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Colon / Rectal Cancer (general reference)

institution.provenance: ONCOTREE grounded Standard Protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

premedications.name: Antiemetic prophylaxis
premedications.notes: Low-to-moderate emetogenic oral therapy; provide antiemetic prophylaxis per emetic-risk framework as needed.

supportiveCare: Take within 1 hour after morning and evening meals.
Myelosuppression is dose-limiting; hold and dose-reduce for severe neutropenia, febrile neutropenia, or severe thrombocytopenia per standard refractory-line practice.
Bevacizumab may be combined in refractory metastatic colorectal cancer (separate biologic, no dose here).
monitoring: CBC with differential before each cycle and on day 15 of each cycle
Assess for febrile neutropenia and GI toxicity between cycles

drugs.name: Trifluridine-Tipiracil
drugs.notes: Trifluridine-tipiracil 35 mg/m2/dose (based on the trifluridine component) orally twice daily on days 1-5 and 8-12 of a 28-day cycle, then 16 days off. Single-dose cap of 80 mg (trifluridine component); round to available tablet strengths. Refractory-line therapy for metastatic colorectal cancer after fluoropyrimidine, oxaliplatin, and irinotecan; may be given with bevacizumab. Dose derived from standard refractory-line practice (own wording, general references).
